notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware run was made and no hardware is supported. The card's entry symbols were confirmed in the clone at python/bricksim/envs/assemble_brick/env.py:506, :520 and :527. Because the registered environment is the external isaaclab.envs:ManagerBasedRLEnv (python/bricksim/envs/assemble_brick/__init__.py:9), native is the in-tree config class AssembleBrickEnvCfg, the card's first entry symbol; the fake is the package's own pure Python kinematic stand-in for the environment that class configures. Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab were not installed or run, and the fake was never compared with them; a backend name outside backends (sim) is served by gymnasium.make(env_id) after installing the package with its isaacsim/isaaclab extras (python/pyproject.toml:17-19), and that path was not run. NOT COVERED: the 720x1280 RGB and depth image arrays of the RGB and RGB-D configurations (python/bricksim/envs/assemble_brick/env.py:154-165 and :197-221); this package serves only the state-based Lego-AssembleBrick-v0 configuration, which removes the cameras and the image group (env.py:506-516). The fake's observation keeps the policy and privileged group structure (a 23-number policy group and the eight privileged terms) but is a scalar-gap kinematic model; its reward and canned poses are placeholders. Warnings are expected of this family driver: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge only stages the seed for the next reset), five G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for the Gymnasium environment interface (action_space, observation_space, reset, step, close) on a config class whose base lies outside the clone, and four G8.NO_UNIT for bridge-derived inputs (ticks, action.values, and seed in reset and seed). Only standard catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
